Hi Samira / Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet the Nimbus team. Quick recap and the items we discussed so we have a shared action list: 

Summary of needs (from your side)
- PHI will be sent to the inference pipeline (clinical notes + structured data).
- Nimbus requires a signed BAA before production.
- SOC 2 attestation (Type II preferred) will be requested during procurement; you will need sample artifacts/evidence for the audit.
- Audit log retention & exportability (for compliance and occasional third-party audits).
- Expected steady-state throughput ~120 tokens/s across peak slots (bursty daytime), with a latency SLO of <250ms for p95.

Open qualification questions we need you to confirm
1) Preferred hosting model: Hosted API vs Dedicated reserved capacity vs Private (VPC/on-prem). Which is your current preference? You mentioned Dedicated during the call but flagged VPC for audit — please confirm.
2) Required log retention period (years). You mentioned 5+ years — can you confirm exact retention and whether exports must be delivered in a specific format?
3) DPO / security contact for the audit packet (who should we send the SOC 2 evidence pack to?).

What Redwood can provide (initial):
- Draft BAA for review (attached).
- SOC 2 evidence checklist mapping to what we can provide immediately vs what requires scoped work (attached).
- Option details: Hosted API (rapid onboarding), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools + isolated tenancy), Private (customer-managed VPC or on-prem package).
- KMS integrations (cloud KMS/HSM) and logging hooks (per-tenant audit streams) — details below will be filled by Karthik.

Attachments included: BAA-draft-Nimbus.docx, Nimbus-SOC2-Checklist-v1.xlsx, Dedicated-configuration-template.pdf

Next steps
- Can you confirm preferred hosting option and your DPO contact by EOD Monday?
- I'll propose two times for a focused security deep-dive with Karthik and Naomi (30 min) to walk the SOC 2 evidence items.

If you prefer, happy to route a short summary to procurement with the proposed timeline and required artifacts.

Thanks,

Hi Samira / Tom — quick technical responses inline to the bullet items you called out: 

> Can Redwood provide per-tenant audit logs (immutable) and a way to export them on request to a SFTP/secure drive?
Yes — Dedicated deployments include per-tenant audit streams. We persist append-only logs for requests, auth events, and admin actions. Export options: scheduled exports to customer S3 buckets, on-demand export (CSV/JSON) to SFTP, or secure transfer to a supported cloud drive. We can also provide signed digests for exported batches (for chain-of-custody).

> KMS: we use a customer-managed KMS in AWS; will you support customer-managed key wrapping (CMK) and HSM-backed keys?
Yes — we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and equivalent GCP/Azure services. For Dedicated and Private VPC deployments we can enable key wrapping so keys never leave your KMS. HSM-backed keys supported via KMS integrations; for Private on-prem HSMs, we can integrate via KMIP where applicable (implementation work required).

> Timeline: if we sign a commitment for Dedicated, what is the expected delivery time (provisioning + BAA execution + evidence handoff) before we can go into production?
Typical timeline: 4–6 weeks for standard Dedicated with BAA execution (assuming no custom network/appliance work). If you require VPC peering + customer-managed KMS + extended evidence packaging for SOC 2, plan for 6–8 weeks. We can compress this with prioritized engineering support (expedite option).

Additional notes
- Retention: default audit retention configurable; we support 1–7+ years depending on storage class. Exports for audits can be automated per your schedule.
- Evidence: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 report and an SOC letter of attestation; full artifact packs (logs, configs) provided under NDA/BAA for auditors.
- Security deep-dive: recommend a 30–45 min call where we walk through the SOC 2 checklist and exchange DPO contact info.

Link: SOC2 evidence map (internal) — https://drive.google.com/nimbus-evidence-pack

I'll join the deep-dive; Naomi can cover process and runbook items.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
